# Sample Commercial Property Wording (fictional)

> Written for testing only. Not a real policy, wording or company document, and contains no customer data.

## Section 1. Cover

### CP-1.1 Buildings
We cover the buildings shown in the schedule against direct physical loss or damage from a peril listed in CP-1.3.

### CP-1.2 Business interruption
We cover the loss of gross profit during the period of indemnity, up to the limit shown in the schedule, when the
interruption results from damage covered by CP-1.1.

### CP-1.3 Perils
Fire, lightning, explosion, aircraft, riot, storm and water damage from bursting pipes.

## Section 2. Exclusions

### CP-2.1 Excluded property
We do not cover money, securities, vehicles licensed for road use, or property while being worked upon.

### CP-2.2 Wear and tear
We do not cover wear, tear, gradual deterioration, rust, corrosion or faulty workmanship.
